raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`initialize_dummy_weights` only initializes floating-point tensors. MXFP8 layers allocate their UE8M0 block scales (`weight_scale_inv`) as `torch.uint8` zeros (`fp8.py`, MoE and linear `create_weights`), so with `--load-format dummy` those scales stay 0. In UE8M0, 0 means 2^-127, so every MXFP8 weight dequantizes to roughly zero. The MXFP8 layers then produce near-zero outputs, which can propagate to NaN downstream.

## Modifications

- `initialize_dummy_weights`: fill uint8 `*weight_scale_inv` tensors with 127 (2^0), the UE8M0 counterpart of the existing neutral FP4 global scales (filled with 1.0).
- Unit test `test_ue8m0_dummy_block_scales_are_neutral` next to `test_nvfp4_dummy_scales_are_neutral`.

## Accuracy Tests

Affects only `--load-format dummy`; real checkpoints load their own scales.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

detail.title: [Fix] model_loader: Neutral UE8M0 block scales for dummy weights

files.patch:
@@ -1756,6 +1756,11 @@ def initialize_dummy_weights(
     the parameter's number of elements and its data type.
     """
     for name, param in model.state_dict().items():
+        # UE8M0 MXFP8 block scales (uint8): 127 is 2**0. Left at zero, every
+        # MXFP8 weight scales to 2**-127.
+        if name.endswith("weight_scale_inv") and param.dtype == torch.uint8:
+            param.fill_(127)
+            continue
         if torch.is_floating_point(param):
             # Neutral FP4 global scales keep fused gate/up projections compatible.
             if name.endswith(("weight_scale_inv", "weight_scale_2")):

@@ -267,6 +267,20 @@ def test_nvfp4_dummy_scales_are_neutral(self):
         self.assertTrue(torch.equal(model.w2_weight_scale_2, torch.ones(4)))
         self.assertTrue(torch.all((model.weight >= 0.25) & (model.weight <= 0.75)))
 
+    def test_ue8m0_dummy_block_scales_are_neutral(self):
+        model = torch.nn.Linear(8, 4, bias=False)
+        model.register_buffer(
+            "w13_weight_scale_inv", torch.zeros(4, 2, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        )
+
+        initialize_dummy_weights(model, low=0.25, high=0.75)
+
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(
+                model.w13_weight_scale_inv, torch.full((4, 2), 127, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            )
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
